name: Venture Co. Documents
summary: In eastern Mulgore, Venture Co. Documents expose the company's illegal mining in tauren lands. Recovered from a crate in a ruined caravan, the papers record its operations.

sections.title: Evidence of Exploitation
sections.body: Venture Co. Documents lay atop mined ore in a ransacked wagon. Their ledgers show that the goblin-led cartel has set up drilling and mining outposts in Mulgore's eastern foothills. Across Kalimdor, the Venture Company is known for ruthless deforestation and uncontrolled excavation. Morin Cloudstalker and the tauren Outrunners study the seized records to judge the threat to their sacred ancestral plains and rally hunters against the trespassers.

faq.q: What do the Venture Co. Documents contain?
faq.answer: The papers detail the Venture Company's mining and extraction in eastern Mulgore. They show the goblin enterprise harvesting and carrying away the region's mineral wealth.

aliases: where do i find the documents
faq.answer: The papers were found in a sealed Venture Company crate among the wreckage of a ransacked wagon at the Ravaged Caravan site, east of Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Who needs to see these papers?
aliases: who do i bring documents to
faq.answer: Bring the papers to Morin Cloudstalker, a tauren hunter stationed along the main trail east of Bloodhoof Village. He watches over Mulgore's security.

faq.q: Why are the Venture Company mining in Mulgore?
faq.answer: The Venture Company mines for profit, seeking rich mineral veins and untamed territories to strip of valuable ore. It has no regard for native treaties, spiritual customs, or the environment.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know goblin machinery defiles the Earth Mother's sacred earth. These papers help the elders confirm the extent of the desecration and launch retaliatory strikes.
As a miner, you can see why the raw mineral samples packed beside the papers matter. They show that the foothills hold rich, untapped veins ripe for excavation.
